highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.0 adds Graphite GPU bindings and asynchronous pixel readback on the Skia m152 engine.
highlights_body: This release adds new GPU and pixel-access capabilities, strengthens native lifetime safety, and broadens package and platform support.

bullets.lead: Skia updated through Chrome m152 servicing
bullets.detail: Moves the bundled renderer to Chrome milestone 152 and incorporates subsequent upstream stability and servicing fixes.
Adds managed bindings for Skia's Graphite backend on Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn.
SKImage and SKSurface can now request pixel readback asynchronously through a backend-neutral API.

bullets.lead: Native-backed pixel and region objects remain valid
bullets.detail: Roots pixel sources and regions while native operations use them, preventing use-after-free failures in subset, With*, and span-iteration operations.

bullets.lead: Raster image creation and uniform resets release resources correctly
bullets.detail: Fixes a pixel-buffer allocation leak after raster creation failure and disposes the previous runtime-effect uniform buffer on reset.

bullets.lead: Vulkan and Apple package support expanded
bullets.detail: Adds the Vulkan Silk.NET package and Apple native symbol packages, with corresponding production packaging support.
Uses FreeType to provide font support on Nano Server.

contributor_summaries.jeffska: Nano Server font support through FreeType
contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Graphite GPU backend bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn

preview_summaries.v4.152.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 introduced the m152 engine update, Graphite GPU bindings, asynchronous pixel readback, and native lifetime fixes.
preview_summaries.v4.152.0-rc.1.26426.14: The release candidate completed packaging and platform support, then incorporated additional m152 servicing and reliability fixes.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzz shaping avoids an unnecessary feature-array copy, and non-memory-backed streams are released correctly when converted to blobs.

v4.152.0-preview.1.1.headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.0 Preview 1 introduces Graphite GPU bindings and asynchronous pixel readback.
v4.152.0-preview.1.1.body: It also updates the bundled renderer to Chrome m152 and improves native object lifetime safety.

v4.152.0-rc.1.26426.14.headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.0 Release Candidate completes the m152 feature set and platform packaging.
v4.152.0-rc.1.26426.14.body: It includes additional upstream renderer servicing and reliability fixes before the stable release.

v4.152.0.headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.0 ships Graphite GPU bindings and asynchronous pixel readback on the Chrome m152 engine.
v4.152.0.body: The release also improves native lifetime safety and expands Vulkan, Apple-symbol, and Nano Server support.
